def zoom(box, scale, out, grid=25):
    c = im.crop(box)
    c = c.resize((c.width*scale, c.height*scale), Image.LANCZOS)

    x = x0 - (x0 % grid)
    while x <= box[2]:

        d.text((X+2,2), str(x), fill=(255,0,0))
        x += grid
    y = y0 - (y0 % grid)
    while y <= box[3]:
        Y = (y-y0)*scale
        d.line([(0,Y),(c.width,Y)], fill=(0,150,255), width=1)
        d.text((2,Y+2), str(y), fill=(0,150,255))
        y += grid
    c.save(out)

import numpy as np

# 2D drawing coordinates (x right, y UP = -drawing_y, z toward viewer: bold=+, dash=-)
# Atom positions from image analysis (drawing px, y flipped):
pos = {
 10:(520,-235), 9:(415,-260), 1:(600,-340), 11:(455,-138), 14:(648,-205),
 13:(650,-85), 12:(530,-45), 15:(750,-262), 16:(850,-200), 32:(850,-80),
 35:(745,-25), 33:(950,-35), 34:(1050,-85), 17:(952,-258), 18:(952,-378),
 30:(830,-455), 19:(1065,-445),
}
ZW=120.0  # wedge/dash depth
def v3(atom, z=0.0):
    x,y = pos[atom]; return np.array([x,y,z],float)

def det_chirality(center, a,b,c,d, za,zb,zc,zd):
    va=v3(a,za)-v3(center); vb=v3(b,zb)-v3(center)
    vc=v3(c,zc)-v3(center); vd=v3(d,zd)-v3(center)
    M=np.array([va-vd, vb-vd, vc-vd])
    return np.linalg.det(M)

def rs(det):
    return 'R' if det<0 else 'S'

# Center 10 (spiro): priorities 1(C=O) > 14(B) > 9(aryl) > 11(CH2)
# wedges: 9 bold(+), 1 dash(-); 14,11 plane
print("10:", rs(det_chirality(10, 1,14,9,11, -ZW,0,ZW,0)))

# Center 14 (bridgehead): priorities 13(N) > 10(spiro) > 15(Q4) > H(at ~(700,-150), dash)
pos[900]=(700,-150)  # pseudo atom H on 14
print("14:", rs(det_chirality(14, 13,10,15,900, 0,0,0,-ZW)))

# Center 16 (Q3): priorities 32(Q2) > 17(L1,bold) > 15(Q4) > H(estimated)
# H estimated as negative sum of unit vectors
c=v3(16); va=v3(32)-c; vb=v3(17,ZW)-c; vc=v3(15)-c
ua,ub,uc=[x/np.linalg.norm(x) for x in (va,vb,vc)]
ud=-(ua+ub+uc)
vd=ud*c and ud  # unit dir
M=np.array([ua-ud, ub-ud, uc-ud])
print("16:", rs(np.linalg.det(M)))

# Center 18 (C1'): priorities 30(N) > 19(I2) > 17(L1) > H(at ~(860,-325), dash)
pos[901]=(860,-325)
print("18:", rs(det_chirality(18, 30,19,17,901, 0,0,0,-ZW)))

# Center 32 (Q2): priorities 35(Q1) > 16(Q3) > 33(vinyl,dash) > H(estimated)
c=v3(32); va=v3(35)-c; vb=v3(16)-c; vc=v3(33,-ZW)-c
ua,ub,uc=[x/np.linalg.norm(x) for x in (va,vb,vc)]
ud=-(ua+ub+uc)
M=np.array([ua-ud, ub-ud, uc-ud])
print("32:", rs(np.linalg.det(M)))

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np

smi = "C=C[C@H]1CN2CC[C@@]3(C(=O)Nc4cc(O)ccc43)[C@@H]2C[C@@H]1C[C@H]1c2[nH]c3ccccc3c2CCN1C"
m = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi)
m = Chem.AddHs(m)

best = None
for seed in range(20):
    params = AllChem.ETKDGv3()
    params.randomSeed = seed
    params.useSmallRingTorsions = True
    conf_ids = AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(m, numConfs=10, params=params)
    if len(conf_ids) > 0:
        best = seed
        break
print("embedded with seed", best, "confs:", len(conf_ids))

# Optimize each conformer with MMFF and keep the best
res = AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMoleculeConfs(m, maxIters=2000)
energies = [r[1] for r in res]
print("MMFF energies:", [round(e,1) for e in energies])
bestconf = int(np.argmin(energies))
print("best conf:", bestconf, energies[bestconf])

# verify stereochemistry from 3D
Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(m, confId=bestconf)
for a in m.GetAtoms():
    if a.HasProp('_CIPCode'):
        print(a.GetIdx(), a.GetSymbol(), a.GetProp('_CIPCode'))

# write XYZ of best conformer
conf = m.GetConformer(bestconf)
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
    f.write(f"{m.GetNumAtoms()}\nC30H34N4O2 built from 2D drawing (mol_0123)\n")
    for a in m.GetAtoms():
        p = conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx())
        f.write(f"{a.GetSymbol()} {p.x:.5f} {p.y:.5f} {p.z:.5f}\n")
print("written answer.xyz, atoms:", m.GetNumAtoms())
EOF
